## Institutional impact

### Homepage, propagation, and control-plane state

- Homepage impact: `updated | no_change | delta_opened`
- Documentation impact: `docs_updated | docs_no_change | docs_delta_opened`
- [ ] Current phase / hard-gate posture remains accurate
- [ ] Material source pulls, provider/domain/API verification, roadmap changes, and corrections were propagated beyond directly edited files
- [ ] Affected macro/corridor/platform/object/article/changelog/machine-seed/phase-gate records were updated or explicitly classified no-change
- [ ] The homepage was updated when a headline institutional claim, primary control state, source census, ruleset posture, or primary navigation path changed
- [ ] Evidence references support the propagation decision

### Rights, IP, culture, and canon

- [ ] Chain of title / license scope checked where applicable
- [ ] Cultural Imprint Engine / canon review addressed
- [ ] Protected identities, minors, likeness, voice, or confidential source boundaries addressed
- [ ] No third-party or restricted material was submitted without authority

### Legal and policy

- [ ] Applicable Legal Depot policies/addenda identified
- [ ] Historical legal claims are not presented as current without evidence
- [ ] Professional-review gates are identified and not overstated

### Security, privacy, and data

- [ ] Visibility/data class recorded
- [ ] No secrets or restricted records are exposed
- [ ] Tenant, role, relationship, purpose, retention, export, and deletion implications addressed
- [ ] Incident, rollback, backup, or recovery impact addressed

### Commerce and economics

- [ ] Product, price, payment, order, entitlement, license, refund, dispute, commission, royalty, or allocation states remain distinct
- [ ] Economic schedules are versioned and authorized
- [ ] No checkout or availability claim exceeds tested fulfillment/support state

### API, MCP, vendor, and deployment

- [ ] Provider/product/version, base URLs, authentication, scopes, endpoints, events, and failure behavior are evidence-backed
- [ ] MCP protocol/tool side effects and approval classes are explicit
- [ ] Vendor export/replacement and deployment/rollback paths are recorded

### Search, accessibility, and public claims

- [ ] Metadata, canonical, robots, sitemap, redirects, structured data, and accessibility impact addressed
- [ ] Dynamic claims include definition, source, period, evidence, owner, and refresh/expiration
- [ ] Programmatic or generated content provides real differentiated value
